template.hear-myself.title: Hear yourself

cable.title: Virtual cable
cable.whatFor: To send sound from SoundBimba into Discord, OBS or a game as a microphone, you need the free VB-CABLE virtual cable. SoundBimba does not install it — you do it yourself, once.
cable.notFound: Cable not found. Install it with the steps below.
cable.step1: Open the official website in your browser:
cable.step2: Download the VB-CABLE archive for Windows and unpack it to any folder.
cable.step4: Click “Install Driver” and wait until it finishes.
cable.step5: Restart the computer and click “Check again”.
cable.testing: Sending a quiet test signal through the cable… About two seconds.
cable.works: The link works. Latency ≈ {output} ms, ≈ {total} ms including sound capture.
cable.failed: The test signal did not arrive. Check that “CABLE Output” is not disabled in Windows sound settings and try again.
cable.tip: In Discord, OBS or a game choose the “CABLE Output” microphone. In SoundBimba — the “Virtual microphone” node.
welcome.title: Hi! This is SoundBimba
welcome.text: Here you build sound like a diagram: sources on the left (apps, microphone, sound buttons), outputs on the right (headphones, virtual microphone), wires in between. Where shall we start?
empty.title: The map is empty
empty.hint: Take a ready-made setup, or add nodes with “Add node” and connect them with wires — from the dot on a node’s right to the dot on another’s left.
clear.title: Clear everything?
clear.text: All nodes and wires will be removed from the map. This cannot be undone. If you may need the setup later, save it first with “Project → Export”.
templates.mineEmpty: Nothing here yet. Save the current map as a template or open a template file (.bmb).
templates.saveCurrentEmpty: The map is empty — nothing to save.
templates.name: Name
templates.exportTitle: Save the template to a .bmb file to share it
templates.deleteConfirm: Delete the template “{name}”? This cannot be undone.
reason.not-template: this is not a SoundBimba template
reason.newer-template: the template was made by a newer SoundBimba
templates.deleteBuiltinConfirm: Remove “{name}” from the list? You can bring it back with “Restore deleted”.
node.compressor.title: Compressor
node.compressor.desc: Evens out loudness: makes loud parts quieter, then raises everything. Your voice sounds steadier and louder, without overload.
preset.louder.hint: Lifts quiet speech a lot, keeps loud parts from overloading
preset.strong.hint: Dense even sound, like on the radio
param.thresholdHint: From what loudness to start compressing. The lower, the more often it works.
param.ratioHint: How many times to squeeze what is above the threshold. 1:1 — no compression.
param.makeupHint: How much to raise the whole sound after compression.
param.attackHint: How fast to start compressing when it gets loud.
param.releaseHint: How fast to let go when it gets quieter.
